intro.title: What is this app?
intro.subtitle: A quick tour of the Claim Billing Request System
intro.p1: This is a proof-of-concept insurance claim billing demo: submit claims, review them, and watch a small dashboard update. Its real purpose is to give the AI PR-review agent realistic code to review — the app exists so there is something meaningful to open pull requests against.
intro.p2: Data lives in memory on the backend (http://localhost:8008), so everything resets when the server restarts. Use the tabs above to move between the Dashboard, the claims list, and the submit form.

submit.title: Submit a new claim
submit.subtitle: The "Submit New Claim" tab
items: Patient Name, Policy Number and Claim Amount are required (marked with *); Description is optional.
The amount must be greater than zero.
New claims start as pending. On success you are taken back to the claims list and the new row appears at the top.

view.title: View, filter, search, sort & paginate
view.subtitle: The "View Claims" tab
items: The table lists every claim with ID, patient, policy number, amount, approved / rejected / pending status, and submitted date. Stat tiles above it show live totals.

Filter by Status with the dropdown, or search by Policy No. using the input plus its Search button. These hit the backend; the stat tiles reflect the active filter, not the full data set. Use Clear filters to reset.
Search (the free-text box) narrows the loaded rows by patient name, policy number or description — this happens in the browser.
Sort by clicking a column header (ID, Patient, Amount, Status, Submitted); click again to flip between ascending and descending.
Long lists paginate — use Prev / Next when more than one page is available.
Hit ↻ Refresh to reload from the backend.

rowActions.title: Approve, reject, edit, view & delete
rowActions.subtitle: Row actions in the claims table
items: View (or clicking the #id) opens a detail drawer with the full claim, including its description.
Approve / Reject set the claim's status. The matching button is disabled when the claim is already in that state.
Edit opens a modal to change the claim's fields and save.
Delete removes the claim after a confirmation prompt — this cannot be undone.

dashboard.title: Dashboard summary
dashboard.subtitle: The "Dashboard" tab
dashboard.p1: The Dashboard shows aggregate totals — total claims, counts by status, and the summed claim amount. These numbers are computed on the server (via /api/claims/summary), which is different from the client-side tallies shown on the claims list. Use ↻ Refresh to recompute after making changes.

theme.title: Light / dark theme
theme.subtitle: The toggle in the header
theme.p1: Use the 🌙 Dark / ☀️ Light button in the top-right to switch themes. Your choice is saved in the browser (localStorage), so it sticks between visits. On the very first visit the app follows your operating system's preference.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: The selector in the header
language.p1: Use the language selector in the top-right to switch between English, Spanish, Arabic and Hindi. Arabic switches the layout to right-to-left. Your choice is saved in the browser (localStorage) and restored on your next visit.
